requirements.title: Level-3 expressions are the character concatenation layer over level-2 expressions
requirements.definition: Level-3 expressions are level-2 expressions optionally involving concat-op. This places concatenation above relational and logical operations but below numeric level-2 syntax in the grammar ladder.

pending.level-2-base: PENDING positive-control source shape using a character primary or level-2-compatible expression as a level-3 expression with literal string oracle. No concat-op is required.
pending.concatenation-layer: PENDING positive-control source shape 'ab'//'cd' assigned to CHARACTER(4) with literal oracle 'abcd'. Character interpretation remains 10.1.5.3.
pending.left-concatenation-chain: PENDING source-only plan for the unparenthesized chain 'a'//'b'//'c'. With intrinsic character operands, a literal value oracle can admit the chain and check the final value 'abc', but it cannot observe R1011 left grouping because 10.1.5.3 p3 states that parentheses specifying character-expression order have no effect on the value. The concrete future grouping route is a derived type with a non-associative defined extension of intrinsic operator //, distinct literal-bearing operands a,b,c, and an oracle comparing the unparenthesized result with independently computed component values for (a//b)//c versus a//(b//c). Defined-operation applicability and interpretation remain owned by 10.1.6 and 15.4.3.4.2.

requirements.oracle: Intrinsic character controls use fixed character literals and length checks only for admission and final value, not grouping. Grouping-sensitive future controls may instead use a non-associative defined extension of // on a derived type, with independently computed component-value oracles and valid interfaces under 10.1.6 and 15.4.3.4.2.

requirements.title: A level-3 expression is a left-recursive chain of level-2 expressions joined by concat-op
requirements.definition: The level-3-expr syntax is either a level-2-expr or a level-3-expr followed by concat-op and level-2-expr, making unparenthesized concatenation left-recursive in the grammar.

pending.single-concat: PENDING positive-control source shape 'x'//'y' with literal oracle 'xy'. R1012 owns the token.
pending.left-recursive-concat: PENDING source-only grouping facet: R1011 makes the unparenthesized concat chain left-recursive. For intrinsic character operands, 10.1.5.3 p3 makes (x//y)//z and x//(y//z) have the same character value and length, so value cannot distinguish grouping. A viable future control uses a derived type with a non-associative defined extension of //, operands carrying independent literal values such as 1, 2, and 3, and a result component whose expected value is computed independently for left grouping and differs from the parenthesized right-grouping control. The defined-operation semantics used by that route are dependencies on 10.1.6 and 15.4.3.4.2.

review_rationale: Independent source review in doc/source_audits/batch_098.json reads all50 original base units and131 fine units of the 10.1.1 and 10.1.2 expression chain, derives the precedence structure independently from the grammar, and verifies all502 grammar heads. The derived chain is primary, then defined unary, then power, then multiply and divide, then unary plus and minus, then binary plus and minus, then concatenation, then a single relation, then NOT, AND, OR and finally EQV and NEQV, with defined binary operators lowest; the catalogue text matches that chain at that granularity. Five blocking findings were raised and closed before this record. Three replaced oracles that could not work: a literal value cannot observe the grouping of an associative operator, and an execution-path oracle cannot observe AND grouping because the standard does not require short-circuit evaluation. One moved a defined-binary rejection from R1023 syntax to the applicability and generic-resolution owners 10.1.6 and 15.4.3.4.2. The fifth corrected the replacement text itself, which had claimed unobservability too broadly: grouping is unobservable only for intrinsic operands, while a non-associative defined extension of the same operator symbol makes it observable by value, and that route is now recorded as the concrete future shape. Expression interpretation, evaluation and constant expressions remain owned by 10.1.3 through 10.1.12 and intrinsic assignment by the registered 10.2.1.3. All facets remain pending source plans; no case, execution, oracle or fixture approval is created.
